items.title: Did crypto’s $20 Billion DeFi surge just get stolen by price inflation?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The $20 billion DeFi surge highlights the impact of price inflation on liquidity, which could affect Solana's market positioning and investor confidence.

items.title: Solana’s blockchain gaming debate is shifting: Web3 opportunity may be moving around the game
items.whyYouShouldCare: The evolving debate around blockchain gaming on Solana indicates a potential shift in Web3 opportunities, which could enhance ecosystem engagement and attract new developers.

items.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increased transaction sizes on Solana, now over three times larger, suggest improved network efficiency, which may enhance its competitiveness against Ethereum.
